overview.description: Construction-only first row, then enlarged steel and foundation model timelines on alternating sides among field clips. No baked montage captions. Whole video frames fit with white gutters; illustrative-date and concept provenance appears outside the montage.

field_and_visits.note: Previously published portfolio sources. Start offsets and tile layout are defined in the build script.

jobsite_photos.processing: Existing published files reused unchanged; responsive gallery crops presentation only.

steel_schedule.source_project: OpenYap GC schedule and steel viewer
steel_schedule.capture: Actual schedules.js UI, model-link.js date coloring, steel-3d renderer and schedule command bridge. Local v4 geometry, isolated from live services. Recaptured with actual zoom gestures to enlarge the model.
steel_schedule.data_note: Illustrative January 2030 sequence dates; not reported field progress. Gray elements remain unlinked.
steel_schedule.processing: 120 browser frames across illustrative January 2030 dates, 12-second 1280x720 silent H.264 faststart clip at 24fps. No added caption badge.

foundation_schedule.source_project: OpenYap GC schedule with YapGrid foundation viewer
foundation_schedule.capture: Actual OYGcs Model mode, YapGrid iframe, model-link.js paint function and tintLayers API; 734 concrete ranges. Model framed closely; statistics and grid bubbles hidden.
foundation_schedule.data_note: Illustrative January 2030 spatial pour zones, not reported completion or actual planned pour sequencing.
foundation_schedule.processing: 12-second 1280x720 silent H.264 faststart, 24fps. No added caption badge.

mep_interface.capture: Actual mep.js, mep.css, and host CSS: Where interface with level filters, equipment map and building grids; archived data, no live services or writes.
mep_interface.scope: 391 equipment overall; L250 selected, 144 equipment. Archive has no drawing background, so this is not a drawing-overlay capture.
